description: This file implements WiFi network scanning functionalities for the RDK platform, including event handling, asynchronous SSID retrieval, filtering, and managing scan operations.

classes.name: WifiManagerScan
classes.description: Class managing WiFi scan operations, event handling, and filtering for the RDK platform.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Registers event handlers for WiFi SSID availability events.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Unregisters event handlers for WiFi SSID availability events.

methods.name: startScan
methods.description: Initiates an asynchronous WiFi scan, optionally filtering by SSID and frequency, and handles incremental scans.

methods.name: getAvailableSSIDsAsync
methods.description: Requests the list of available SSIDs asynchronously via IARM bus.

methods.name: getAvailableSSIDsAsyncIncr
methods.description: Requests incremental SSID list asynchronously, with staged results.

methods.name: stopScan
methods.description: Cancels an ongoing incremental WiFi scan.

methods.name: iarmEventHandler
methods.description: Handles WiFi SSID availability events from the IARM bus, parses JSON data, applies filters, and triggers callbacks.

methods.name: applyFilter
methods.description: Filters SSID list based on regex match for SSID and frequency.
